member.name: T:Microsoft.Xbox.Core.RuntimeExtensions
member.summary: Console-specific helpers for the Xbox 360 runtime.

member.name: M:Microsoft.Xbox.Core.RuntimeExtensions.SetThreadProcessorAffinity(System.Threading.Thread,System.Int32[])
member.summary: Restricts a managed thread to run on the specified hardware threads of the console's CPU. Use it to keep a background worker (decoding, parsing, networking) off the hardware thread that runs the UI.
member.param: The hardware thread numbers the thread may run on.
member.remarks: Forwards to the console runtime's Thread.SetProcessorAffinity, which validates the values.

member.name: M:Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Audio.SoundEffect.Finalize
member.summary: Releases the native sound data and any remaining instances of this sound effect if was not called.
